messages:
samira: Postmortem follow-up: overnight cache paging keeps happening during autoscaling. We sketched fixes in the doc but need owners, quick mitigations, and a short validation plan.

cheng: adding context: most pages are memcached_p99 spikes from warm-up after scale events. Many are duplicates across hosts and cause unnecessary pager churn.

frank: concrete ideas: 1) per-cluster p99 thresholds (not global), 2) host-level dedupe key, 3) deploy-time suppression hook. can take 1+2. ETA 48h.

emily: I can own the suppression hook tied to autoscaler events. plan: when ASG/HPAs scale > 10% in 5m, route cache_p99 alerts to #alerts-staging instead of pages for 30m. test in staging first. ETA 24h.

samira: love it. frank -> thresholds+dedupe (48h), emily -> autoscale suppression (24h), cheng -> validation dashboard and baseline (tomorrow AM).

oncall-bot: Reminder: any change that alters paging must include a runbook update in infra/runbooks and be reviewed by @eng-sre.

frank: sample Prom rule for per-cluster p99 (draft):
```yaml
- alert: cache_p99_cluster_high
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(cache_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, cluster)) > 140
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
I'll parameterize cluster thresholds and submit a PR behind a feature flag.

emily: autoscaler hook pseudo: controller emits metric autoscale_event{cluster="X"} = 1 when scaling; suppression rule checks recent autoscale_event and flips routing. will implement as feature-flagged action.

cheng: metrics to track (please include in dashboard): total_cache_alerts/day, night_pagers_22_06, suppressed_alerts, unique_hosts_alerting, pages_per_incident. Success goal: night_pagers down 80% without increase in missed-critical incidents over 2 weeks.

frank: dedupe plan: dedupe_key = host|alert; host cooldown 10m; cluster cooloff 30m. also add rate cutoff: if alerts/sec for cluster > Y then escalate immediately.

emily: example opsctl silence for testing (dry-run):
```
opsctl silence add --alert cache_p99_cluster_high --duration 30m --reason "postmortem tuning - autoscale window" --dry-run
```
I'll convert to real after staging validation.

oncall-bot: Auto: runbook PR required. Tagging @eng-sre required for approval.

samira: small validation cadence: daily snapshot for 7 days, weekly check-in next Friday 09:00 PT. cheng please attach baseline numbers by tomorrow.

cheng: baseline attached to dashboard and posted. initial night_pagers = 46/day.

frank: opened PR for threshold changes behind flag: https://git.internal/alerts/pulls/789. tagging this thread.

emily: hooked suppression into staging autoscaler events; running smoke tests now. will report EOD.

samira: thanks. keep updates short here (one-line status only). closing loop when metrics meet goal or we roll back. :white_check_mark:
